target.title: fix: prevent ClickClack startup backlog replay
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where ClickClack-backed OpenClaw channels could treat old ClickClack messages as new live input after a gateway restart when the ClickClack event backlog spans more than one HTTP page.

The old startup path advanced the cursor through only the first `/api/realtime/events` page before opening the websocket. ClickClack's websocket endpoint is allowed to replay events after the cursor it receives, so older events beyond that first page could be delivered to the OpenClaw channel adapter as if they were fresh messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

The ClickClack gateway now defaults to tail-from-now startup behavior: it drains every historical event page to advance to the true tail cursor without dispatching those old events, then opens the websocket from that tail. Explicit historical dispatch remains available with `backfillOnStart: true`.

The change also adds in-process idempotency for repeated event ids and repeated message ids, covering HTTP/websocket overlap and duplicate websocket delivery during reconnects.

## User Impact

Operators can restart an OpenClaw gateway connected to a ClickClack workspace without old channel messages re-arming agent turns. New ClickClack messages still arrive normally after the gateway subscribes at the tail.

For operators who intentionally want startup backlog dispatch, `channels.clickclack.backfillOnStart: true` preserves that behavior as an explicit opt-in.

## Evidence

Real behavior proof from the stock ClickClack validation service on `http://127.0.0.1:8100`:

```json
{
  "environment": {
    "clickclackUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8100",
    "workspaceId": "wsp_01ktq4zg...mcya",
    "channelId": "chn_01ktq4zg...jts6",
    "realServer": true,
    "transport": "HTTP /api/realtime/events plus WebSocket /api/realtime/ws"
  },
  "staleCursorTrace": {
    "firstHttpPageSize": 200,
    "cursorAfterSinglePage": "cur_01ktyhdc...xf6a",
    "websocketReplayCountFromSinglePageCursor": 501,
    "replayFirstCursor": "cur_01ktyhep...vtrq",
    "replayLastCursor": "cur_01kx2sf2...gyq7"
  },
  "fixedTailDrainTrace": {
    "httpPagesFetchedUntilEmpty": 39,
    "drainedEventCount": 7428,
    "tailCursor": "cur_01kwv3nr...zegk",
    "websocketReplayCountFromTailCursor": 0
  },
  "liveControl": {
    "postedHumanMessageBody": "tail-drain-proof-1783578986767",
    "postedMessageId": "msg_01kx2sf2...y8qz",
    "receivedLiveEventType": "message.created",
    "receivedLiveEventCursor": "cur_01kx2sf2...gyq7",
    "receivedLiveEventMessageId": "msg_01kx2sf2...y8qz"
  },
  "conclusion": "PASS: real ClickClack server replays historical events from a stale single-page cursor, but not from the fully drained tail cursor; live events still arrive after tail subscription."
}
```
